title: Last Day Where You Can Still Cross
goal: Find the last day a land path connects the top row to the bottom row.
strategy: Reverse the flooding process. Reopen cells and union adjacent land components with virtual top and bottom nodes; the first reverse connection identifies the latest feasible day.
